components.name: content_addressed_filesystem
components.role: canonical immutable originals and JSON receipts
components.deployment: local directories with backup/encryption chosen by operator
components.custom_work: object-path convention, atomic writer, receipt JSON Schema, restore test

components.name: SQLite_FTS5
components.role: rebuildable metadata/entity index and BM25 full-text search
components.deployment: in-process local database; verify runtime is compiled with FTS5
components.custom_work: schema, indexer, query CLI, integrity/rebuild tests

components.name: Karakeep
components.role: capture, triage, notes, highlights and review interface
components.deployment: reuse existing local deployment if available; do not install during R3
components.custom_work: bounded official-API exporter and neutral evidence-id link

components.name: Karakeep_MCP
components.role: optional agent interface to concrete Karakeep operations
components.deployment: only after API credentials/permissions are explicitly approved
components.custom_work: none for canonical ingestion; direct API remains preferred for deterministic job

components.name: Docling
components.deployment: pin in isolated environment after compatibility/resource POC; standard pipeline only
components.custom_work: deterministic router, config/version/output receipt, corpus fixtures

components.name: Zotero_and_translators
components.role: optional scholarly capture, bibliographic metadata, annotation and citations
components.deployment: desktop/local; adopt only if academic workflow justifies a second UI

components.name: GROBID
components.deployment: local service/container only if evaluation beats default parser for citations

components.name: OCRmyPDF_Tesseract
components.deployment: local CLI with pinned versions/languages only if scan corpus exists
components.custom_work: image-only detection, command receipt and QA status

components.name: Apache_Tika
components.deployment: local CLI/server only if Docling evaluation leaves a format gap

components.name: DuckDB
components.role: optional batch analytics over exported evidence manifests
components.deployment: reuse existing runtime only; separate evidence lifecycle from operational warehouse
components.custom_work: none until a query need exists

components.name: ArchiveBox
components.custom_work: neutral export adapter if later adopted

components.name: Meilisearch_Typesense_vector_database
components.license: varies; Meilisearch current repository is MIT AND BUSL-1.1

components.name: embeddings_or_LLM_pipeline
components.role: optional semantic retrieval and derived synthesis
components.custom_work: only a rebuildable derived-record contract if later approved

minimal_custom_glue: evidence receipt JSON Schema and content-addressed object writer
deterministic parser router and derivative receipts
SQLite metadata/FTS indexer and query CLI
preimplementation_human_decisions: existing Karakeep deployment and Zotero need
isolated parser/capture POC corpus and pass thresholds
read-only evidence interface and separate promotion governance
